Name: Gifts from Shane - One Letter at a Time
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[size=3]Strengthen your friendship with Shane and receive valuable items and thoughtful gifts from him – a friendship that heals!

Discover how to make your friend better and help him mature!

And you'll receive some simple gifts that represent your growth as a person.[/size]

[b][size=4]✨ Features[/size][/b]

✔ Unique gifts for every friendship level
✔ Character-themed rewards
✔ Better and better gifts with each new level
✔ Fully lore-friendly gift selections
✔ Repeatable cards with random gifts
✔ Compatible with existing saves
✔ Gifts are reset when the mod is updated.
